metadata.description: SpringBootAI 配置元数据（对齐 Spring Boot additional-spring-configuration-metadata.json）
metadata.note: IDE 可读取此文件提供配置自动补全和文档提示

properties.name: server.port
properties.description: HTTP 服务端口

properties.name: server.host
properties.description: HTTP 服务绑定地址

properties.name: server.request-id.header
properties.description: 请求关联 ID 的请求/响应头名称

properties.name: server.cors.allow-origins
properties.description: CORS 允许的源列表

properties.name: server.cors.allow-credentials
properties.description: CORS 是否允许携带凭证

properties.name: server.csrf.enabled
properties.description: 是否启用 CSRF 防护（Bearer Token 认证无需开启）

properties.name: spring.application.name
properties.description: 应用名称

properties.name: spring.profiles.active
properties.description: 激活的 Profile

properties.name: spring.devtools.restart.enabled
properties.description: 是否启用 DevTools 热重载（仅开发环境）

properties.name: spring.devtools.restart.poll-interval
properties.description: 文件轮询间隔（秒）

properties.name: spring.datasource.url
properties.description: 数据库连接 URL

properties.name: spring.datasource.username
properties.description: 数据库用户名

properties.name: spring.datasource.password
properties.description: 数据库密码

properties.name: spring.datasource.driver-class-name
properties.description: 数据库驱动类名

properties.name: spring.datasource.pool-size
properties.description: 连接池大小

properties.name: spring.ddl-auto.mode
properties.description: DDL 自动生成模式 (none/create/update/validate/create-drop)

properties.name: spring.ddl-auto.entity-packages
properties.description: @Entity 实体类所在包列表

properties.name: spring.security.jwt.secret-key
properties.description: JWT 签名密钥（长度 >= 32，生产环境必须配置）

properties.name: spring.security.jwt.access-token-expiry
properties.description: Access Token 过期时间（秒）

properties.name: spring.security.jwt.refresh-token-expiry
properties.description: Refresh Token 过期时间（秒）

properties.name: spring.security.oauth2.resourceserver.jwt.issuer-uri
properties.description: OAuth2 Authorization Server 的 Issuer URI

properties.name: spring.security.oauth2.resourceserver.jwt.jwk-set-uri
properties.description: OAuth2 JWKS 公钥集 URI

properties.name: spring.rabbitmq.host
properties.description: RabbitMQ 主机

properties.name: spring.rabbitmq.port
properties.description: RabbitMQ 端口

properties.name: spring.kafka.bootstrap-servers
properties.description: Kafka Bootstrap Servers

properties.name: spring.kafka.consumer.group-id
properties.description: Kafka 消费者组 ID

properties.name: spring.kafka.consumer.auto-offset-reset
properties.description: Kafka 消费者 Offset 重置策略 (latest/earliest)

properties.name: spring.redis.host
properties.description: Redis 主机

properties.name: spring.redis.port
properties.description: Redis 端口

properties.name: spring.cloud.nacos.discovery.server-addr
properties.description: Nacos 服务发现地址

properties.name: spring.cloud.config.timeout
properties.description: Spring Cloud Config HTTP 请求超时（毫秒，默认 5000）

properties.name: spring.cloud.config.max-response-size
properties.description: Spring Cloud Config 响应与本地配置文件大小上限（字节）

properties.name: spring.cloud.config.retry.max-attempts
properties.description: Spring Cloud Config 最大请求尝试次数（默认 6，至少 1）

properties.name: spring.cloud.config.retry.initial-interval
properties.description: Spring Cloud Config 初始重试间隔（毫秒，最大 60000）

properties.name: spring.cloud.config.retry.multiplier
properties.description: Spring Cloud Config 重试退避乘数（范围 1-10）

properties.name: logging.diagnose
properties.description: 是否在异常日志中输出帧局部变量；生产环境应保持关闭

properties.name: discovery.timeout
properties.description: Nacos 服务发现请求超时（秒，范围 (0,60]，默认 3）

properties.name: rabbitmq.connection-timeout
properties.description: RabbitMQ 建立连接超时（秒，默认 5）

properties.name: rabbitmq.socket-timeout
properties.description: RabbitMQ TCP socket 超时（秒，默认 5）

properties.name: rabbitmq.stack-timeout
properties.description: RabbitMQ AMQP 握手超时（秒，默认 5）

properties.name: rabbitmq.connection-attempts
properties.description: RabbitMQ 连接尝试次数（默认 1，最大 10）

properties.name: rabbitmq.retry-delay
properties.description: RabbitMQ 连接重试间隔（秒，默认 0）

properties.name: rabbitmq.blocked-connection-timeout
properties.description: RabbitMQ blocked 状态超时（秒，默认 300）

properties.name: spring.cloud.seata.mode
properties.description: Seata 分布式事务模式 (at/tcc/http/distributed)

properties.name: management.endpoints.web.security.enabled
properties.description: Actuator 敏感端点鉴权开关

properties.name: management.endpoints.web.security.roles
properties.description: Actuator 访问角色列表

properties.name: management.config-monitor.enabled
properties.description: 是否记录配置加载与热刷新历史；默认关闭

properties.name: management.config-monitor.include-values
properties.description: 是否在变更事件中包含脱敏后的值；生产环境建议关闭

properties.name: management.config-monitor.history-size
properties.description: 配置监控最多保留的事件数

properties.name: management.config-monitor.refresh-events
properties.description: 是否记录 reload 成功/失败事件

properties.name: management.admin.request-metrics.enabled
properties.description: 是否启用框架内置请求持久化监控；默认关闭

properties.name: management.admin.request-metrics.title
properties.description: Admin 面板应用请求统计卡片标题

properties.name: management.admin.request-metrics.include-paths
properties.description: 需要统计的业务路径白名单；未配置时采集所有非运维路径，例如 ["/api/**"]

properties.name: management.admin.request-metrics.exclude-paths
properties.description: 额外排除的路径；框架始终排除 /actuator/**、接口文档和 favicon

properties.name: management.admin.request-metrics.table
properties.description: 请求持久化监控使用的数据表名；非法名称回退为 springbootai_request_metrics

properties.name: spring.ai.default-provider
properties.description: AI 模型提供商 (openai/deepseek/moonshot/zhipu/ollama)

properties.name: spring.ai.max-retries
properties.description: 模型调用最大总尝试次数；0 表示不重试

properties.name: spring.ai.retry-delay-ms
properties.description: 模型重试间隔（毫秒）

properties.name: spring.ai.request-timeout-seconds
properties.description: 单次模型请求超时（秒）

properties.name: spring.ai.max-output-tokens
properties.description: 单次模型最大输出 Token

properties.name: spring.ai.max-total-tokens
properties.description: 单个模型/工具闭环累计 Token 上限

properties.name: spring.ai.max-tool-iterations
properties.description: 单个请求最多工具调用轮数

properties.name: spring.ai.api-key
properties.description: AI API Key

properties.name: spring.ai.allow-fake
properties.description: 无 API Key 时是否降级 FakeChatModel
